name: Shiplog
author: Joshua Warren
description: A captain's log of what you shipped today: merged PRs, pushed commits, closed issues.

barWidget.description: Today's shipped work at a glance.

schema.label: Sources
schema.description: Where shipped work is read from. GitHub needs `gh auth login`.

options.label: GitHub
options.description: Merged pull requests, closed issues, and pushed commits via the gh CLI

options.label: Local repositories
options.description: Commits authored today in repositories under the folders below

schema.label: Local repo folders
schema.description: Comma-separated folders scanned one level deep for git repositories.

schema.label: Poll interval (minutes)
schema.description: How often Shiplog refreshes. Five minutes is the floor, to stay friendly to the GitHub API.

schema.label: Hide when nothing shipped
schema.description: Remove the chip from the bar entirely until the first item of the day lands.

schema.label: Day boundary
schema.description: Local time the logical day starts, as HH:MM. Night owls can end the day at 04:00.

schema.label: Recap directory
schema.description: Empty disables the archive. When set, the day's log is saved to <dir>/<YYYY-MM-DD>.md at day rollover and via the s key.
